data.observations: The fixed selector exited 1 after 4.03 seconds with 'only 0 covered, semantic, non-duplicate candidates found' and produced no inventory. A retained same-trial diagnostic reproduced the selector classifications over 502 parser candidates: 167 duplicate generated sites, 3 duplicate manual locations, 124 non-semantic-file sites and 208 sites outside modeled semantic functions, leaving zero eligible candidates. No mutation, registry row or batch manifest was written; no mutant build or checker launch occurred.
data.limitations: The preregistered six-candidate observation is missing, so this cannot be classified NO_SIGNAL and cannot show that Nanoda lacks fresh semantic mutation targets. It only characterizes exhaustion of the current pinned source, retained mutation identity set and semantic-diversity-v1 eligibility model. The diagnostic is explanatory raw evidence, not a replacement sample or confirmation result.
data.decision: Stop this one-trial E0 campaign as INCONCLUSIVE and do not create an E1 confirmation proposal. Retain the exact exhaustion counts for future selector/model or source-revision reassessment; choose the next separate project item at campaign handoff.
